summary: Comprehensive testing of FirmaFinder CRM completed - all 22 backend API tests passed (100%), all frontend features working correctly
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/caen-codes returns exactly 9 printing CAEN codes (1811, 1812, 1813, 1814, 1721, 1330, 2222, 7311, 8219)
Backend: GET /api/counties returns 42+ Romanian counties
Backend: POST /api/auth/register - registers with email + phone + password (email required, phone optional)
Backend: POST /api/auth/login - login with email or phone as identifier + password
Backend: GET /api/auth/me - returns current user info with Bearer token
Backend: GET /api/search/caen/{code} - searches mfinante.gov.ro for companies by CAEN code
Backend: GET /api/search?q=TIPAR - search companies by name
Backend: POST /api/companies - save a company (requires auth)
Backend: GET /api/companies - list saved companies (requires auth)
Backend: GET /api/companies/{id} - get single company (requires auth)
Backend: PUT /api/companies/{id} - update company status/details
Backend: DELETE /api/companies/{id} - delete company
Backend: POST /api/reminders - create reminder for a company
Backend: GET /api/reminders - list reminders
Backend: POST /api/reminders/{id}/complete - mark reminder complete
Backend: DELETE /api/reminders/{id} - delete reminder
Backend: GET /api/dashboard/stats - returns pipeline stats
Frontend: Login page loads with Email and Password fields
Frontend: Register mode shows separate Name, Email, Phone, Password fields
Frontend: Search page - CAEN dropdown opens and shows exactly 9 codes using shadcn/Radix Select
Frontend: Search by CAEN code 1812 returns 243 real companies from mfinante.gov.ro
Frontend: Save button saves a lead to pipeline
Frontend: Pipeline page shows Kanban columns (Potential Lead, Prospect, Client, Rejected)
Frontend: Reminders page shows create dialog with shadcn Calendar picker
Frontend: Dashboard page shows stats cards (Total Companies, Potential Leads, Prospects, Clients, Rejected)
seed_data_creation: Admin account seeded on startup via ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working. CAEN search uses live mfinante.gov.ro scraping (takes 5-15 seconds). Use role='option' selector for shadcn/Radix Select dropdowns. SendGrid email sending is NOT configured (SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL is empty) - this is expected as user's sender identity is not verified.

mocked_apis.note: Search results come from LIVE mfinante.gov.ro scraping, NOT mocked. SendGrid email will fail due to missing SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL configuration.
